items.title: David Ayer to Become a Partner at Ryan Kavanaugh's New Location-Defying AI Company (Exclusive)
items.excerpt: Director David Ayer is joining Ryan Kavanaugh's ACME AI as principal and managing partner; its 'Grey Box' tech lets directors shoot on a grey stage and generate locations with AI, which Ayer says makes many location shoots moot.

items.title: Chinese Dubbing Firm Reaps AI Savings, Faces Pricing Pressure
items.excerpt: Chinese language-services integrator Transn has dubbed more than 20,000 microdramas using AI with human review, cutting production time to days, but falling dubbing prices are squeezing it as revenue grows.

items.title: AI로 만든 영화·애니메이션 등 64개 작품 공개…콘진원, 콘텐츠 창작 인재 양성 성과 선보여
items.excerpt: 문체부·한국콘텐츠진흥원의 'AI 크리에이터 쇼케이스 2026'(11/12-14, 코엑스·메가박스)에서 AI 단편영화·애니메이션 등 64개 프로젝트가 공개됐고 2,354명이 찾았다. '선재 업고 튀어' 김태엽 감독 등이 실제 창작 과정의 AI 활용 경험을 공유했다.

items.title: AI가 배우를 대체할 수 있을까…프롬, 배우·감독·제작자 참여 'AI 명작 감상회' 개최
items.excerpt: AI 스토리텔링 랩 프롬이 22일 '인공지능 연기 그리고 배우의 본질'을 주제로 제2회 AI 명작 감상회를 연다. AI 캐릭터 연기 작품 상영·장면 해설과 함께 배우 연기와 AI 캐릭터 제작을 결합하는 '하이브리딩'을 다루며, 12월 19일엔 AI 작품 시상식 '프롬 어워즈'를 처음 연다.

items.title: Make an AI Short Film in Claude | Runway MCP
items.excerpt: Runway walks through making a complete micro film with Claude and the Runway MCP: director's notes, storyboards, character and location references, a four-scene shot list, then multi-shot scene generation in draft mode.

items.title: Final Cut Pro 13 adds MotionVFX for one of the biggest updates ever
items.excerpt: Final Cut Pro 13 folds in the MotionVFX acquisition as Apple's Creator Studio gets AI-era updates, including Pixelmator Pro Generate Fill and MCP support in iWork for external AI agents.

items.title: Tool Tip Tuesday for Adobe Premiere: Color Matching with the AI Assistant (Beta)
items.excerpt: A hands-on look at using Premiere 2027's beta AI Assistant to color-match shots via natural-language requests, released last week at Adobe MAX.

items.title: Christopher Hampton on AI – 'I'm More Interested in Real Intelligence' – and Dos and Don'ts of Screenwriting
items.excerpt: Two-time Oscar-winning writer Christopher Hampton dismisses AI screenwriting in favor of 'real intelligence' while sharing screenwriting advice at Tallinn Black Nights (commentary).

items.title: [REVIEW] AI movie 'Raphael' impresses visually, lacks fresh plot
items.excerpt: Review of Korea's first feature made entirely with generative AI, opening Nov. 25: the 138-minute sci-fi 'Raphael' (Matteo AI Studio with MBC C&I) took 14 months, with AI building characters, landscapes, voices, music and SFX; polished visuals but a formulaic plot.

items.title: A Quick Look at How Adobe's New AI Assistant Could Streamline Your Workflows in Premiere
items.excerpt: Explainer on the Premiere AI Assistant announced at Adobe MAX 2026: what it is and how it automates editing tasks through natural-language commands.

items.title: Adobe Gives Sneak Peek at Real-Time Generative AI Video Editing Feature
items.excerpt: Adobe's Project Live Set research sneak lets creators generate and edit AI video effects while the footage is playing.
